messages:
Devon: Heads-up — starting a phased bring-up for model v3.2-shadow on /chat at 5% traffic. Running contrastive evals + latency probes. Dashboards: https://internal.redwood/dash/ctry-4387 :eyes:
Anya: Which quantized build are we testing? int4 or nf4? :thinking_face:
Devon: int4-qv2 with kv-warm (prefill). Production remains v3.1 fp16. Signals we care about: answer_quality_avg, hallucination_rate, latency_p95, token_cost. Canary gating rule (informal): if answer_quality delta <= -0.03 AND hallucination_rate delta >= +0.01 -> auto-fallback. Also watch longdoc MRR slices seriously.
Liam: Please add slice=legal-longdoc and slice=invoice-parsing to the watchlist — those are fragile for int4.
Maya: Proposed emergency circuit: cut traffic if: (1) quality drops >= 10% relative or (2) p95 latency > 1.5s sustained for 3 consecutive mins. Also set a softer rolling threshold for auto-fallback. :rotating_light:
Devon: deploy-bot: canary ctry-4387 started at 5% traffic (shadow).
deploy-bot: canary ctry-4387 started — monitors armed.
Anya: Ran a small offline A/B on 10k samples. Early signal: answer_quality delta = -0.015, p95 +30ms, hallucination flat. Not alarming but keep an eye.
Liam: Can we run a focused structured-output prompt set (500 samples) to check fidelity? I can run that now.
Anya: Ran structured-output check -> baseline mismatches 8/500, v3.2-shadow 12/500 (delta +4). That's 0.8% increase, below our 1% structured-output guardrail.
Maya: Reminder to enable automatic fallback policy in traffic config: 'if (delta_quality <= -0.025 AND hallucination >= 0.008) OR (p95_latency > 1.0s for 2min) then rollback to v3.1'. Also link to rollout playbook in #eng-ml.
Devon: Noted. Also prefill KV cache to reduce tail with seed 10k. Command used for bring-up:
```
redwoodctl traffic promote --shadow-id ctry-4387 --phase 5% --prefill=10000 --auto-fallback-policy "delta_q<=-0.025 && (halluc>=0.008 || p95>1.0)"
```
Anya: I pushed an alert rule to the canary chart: alert if p95 > 1.0s OR delta_quality < -0.02 for 2 windows. Hooked to #eng-ml-ops.
deploy-bot: Observability event @4387654365 — canary latency p95 1.02s (threshold 1.0s).
Maya: Holding at 5% for now. Do not auto-cut unless the alert persists for 3 consecutive windows (we don't want noisy single-window flips).
Devon: Agreed. If it persists we'll cut to 0% and spin up postmortem. I'll monitor for the next 10m and post updates here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
